tool_schemas.name: brave_web_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Brave Web Search for the given query on behalf of the specified workspace and API key, persists the search request and normalized web result items (optionally storing the raw provider response), and returns up to `count` results starting at zero-based `offset` for pagination. If `cache_ttl_seconds` > 0, identical requests may be served from cache until the TTL expires and the response indicates cached status when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, empty query, out-of-range `count`/`offset`/`cache_ttl_seconds`, invalid locale codes, or unsupported `result_filter`; raises UNAUTHORIZED when the workspace/api key is invalid or not permitted, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace/key has no remaining usage, and PROVIDER_ERROR when Brave rejects the request or is unavailable.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to authenticate, enforce quotas, and attribute stored request/results.

api_key_id.description: API key id to use for the Brave provider request and usage/billing attribution.

count.description: Number of web results to return (provider page size).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the web result set for pagination.

country.description: Two-letter country code to localize results (e.g., US, GB).

search_lang.description: Language code for the search interface (e.g., en, en-US).

ui_lang.description: Language for returned UI strings when supported (e.g., en, en-US).

safesearch.description: SafeSearch level for filtering adult content.

spellcheck.description: Whether to apply provider spellcheck/suggestions when available.

result_filter.description: Restrict returned result sections/types; web-only for this tool.

store_raw_response.description: Whether to store the provider raw response on the search request record.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: If >0, cache identical requests for this many seconds (sets cached_until and may return cached status).

tool_schemas.name: brave_local_search
tool_schemas.description: Executes a Brave Local Search for places/businesses matching the query (optionally biased by `location` latitude/longitude and `radius_km`), persists the search request and normalized local place items (optionally storing the raw provider response), and returns up to `count` results starting at zero-based `offset` for pagination. If `fallback_to_web` is true and local results are empty/insufficient, the request may fall back to a web search and return those results instead; if `cache_ttl_seconds` > 0, identical requests may be served from cache until the TTL expires and the response indicates cached status when applicable. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ids, empty query, out-of-range `count`/`offset`/`cache_ttl_seconds`, invalid locale codes, invalid `location` (missing latitude/longitude or out-of-range coordinates/radius), and raises UNAUTHORIZED when the workspace/api key is invalid or not permitted, QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace/key has no remaining usage, and PROVIDER_ERROR when Brave rejects the request or is unavailable.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to authenticate, enforce quotas, and attribute stored request/results.

api_key_id.description: API key id to use for the Brave provider request and usage/billing attribution.

query.description: Local search query text (business/place/service and/or location intent).

count.description: Number of local place results to return (provider page size).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the local result set for pagination.

country.description: Two-letter country code to localize results (e.g., US, GB).

search_lang.description: Language code for the search interface (e.g., en, en-US).

ui_lang.description: Language for returned UI strings when supported (e.g., en, en-US).

safesearch.description: SafeSearch level for filtering adult content when applicable.

location.description: Optional location bias for local intent.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers for location bias.

fallback_to_web.description: Whether to automatically fall back to web search when local results are empty/insufficient.

store_raw_response.description: Whether to store the provider raw response on the search request record.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: If >0, cache identical requests for this many seconds (sets cached_until and may return cached status).

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search request records for a workspace with optional filtering by status/tool/api key and time range. Returns a paginated page of search_requests ordered by created_at desc; refuses when the workspace is unknown or the caller is not entitled to read it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to scope the list and enforce read access.

api_key_id.description: Optional API key id to filter requests attributed to a specific key.

tool_name.description: Optional tool name to filter by originating integration tool.

status.description: Optional list of statuses to include.

created_from.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp (inclusive) to filter requests created at or after this time.

created_to.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp (exclusive) to filter requests created before this time.

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return in this page.

page_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response to continue pagination.

include_raw_response.description: When true, includes stored raw_response (may be redacted); may be refused for plans/scopes that disallow raw retention.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted search_requests record by id. Returns the request metadata (and optionally raw_response) and refuses when the request is not found or not readable in the specified workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the search request.

include_raw_response.description: When true, includes stored raw_response (may be redacted); may be refused for plans/scopes that disallow raw retention.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized search result items for a given search_request_id, in rank order. Returns a paginated page of search_results; refuses when the request/results are not found or not readable for the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the search request and results.

search_request_id.description: Search request id whose results to list.

result_type.description: Optional filter for result types to include.

status.description: Optional filter for result item lifecycle status.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the ranked result set (rank-ordered).

count.description: Number of result items to return.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record for a workspace for use in Brave provider requests, storing only a hash and last4 for security. Returns the created api_keys record; refuses if the workspace is not active, quotas/policy disallow key creation, or the provider is unsupported.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own and be billed for usage attributed to this key.

provider.description: Provider this key is for (Brave Search).

provider_api_key.description: The raw provider API key to register; it is validated and stored only as a hash/last4.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_api_key(workspace_id, provider, key_name, provider_api_key, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0193000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0193000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    def _iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        return dt.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^brv_ws_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspace_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspace_id.")
    if provider != "brave":
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unsupported provider.")
    if not isinstance(key_name, str) or not (1 <= len(key_name) <= 100):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "key_name must be a non-empty string up to 100 characters.")
    if not isinstance(provider_api_key, str) or not (10 <= len(provider_api_key) <= 500):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "provider_api_key must be between 10 and 500 characters.")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    usage_ledger = _load("usage_ledger.json")

    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if not ws:
        usage_ledger.append({
            "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": None,
            "search_request_id": None,
            "event_type": "request",
            "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
            "quantity": 0,
            "billable": False,
            "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
            "note": "create_api_key.not_found_workspace",
            "status": "NOT_FOUND",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        })
        _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.")
    if ws.get("status") != "active":
        usage_ledger.append({
            "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": None,
            "search_request_id": None,
            "event_type": "request",
            "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
            "quantity": 0,
            "billable": False,
            "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
            "note": "create_api_key.workspace_not_active",
            "status": "UNAUTHORIZED",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        })
        _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Workspace is not active.")

    # Hash and last4
    last4 = provider_api_key[-4:] if len(provider_api_key) >= 4 else None
    key_hash = hashlib.sha256(provider_api_key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    # Enforce unique(workspace_id, provider, key_name) and unique(workspace_id, provider, key_hash)
    for k in api_keys:
        if k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and k.get("provider") == provider:
            if k.get("key_name") == key_name:
                usage_ledger.append({
                    "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
                    "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                    "api_key_id": None,
                    "search_request_id": None,
                    "event_type": "request",
                    "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
                    "quantity": 0,
                    "billable": False,
                    "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
                    "created_at": _iso(now),
                    "updated_at": _iso(now),
                    "note": "create_api_key.conflict_key_name",
                    "status": "CONFLICT",
                    "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
                })
                _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
                return _err("CONFLICT", "An API key with this key_name already exists for this workspace/provider.")
            if k.get("key_hash") == key_hash:
                usage_ledger.append({
                    "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
                    "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                    "api_key_id": None,
                    "search_request_id": None,
                    "event_type": "request",
                    "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
                    "quantity": 0,
                    "billable": False,
                    "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
                    "created_at": _iso(now),
                    "updated_at": _iso(now),
                    "note": "create_api_key.conflict_key_hash",
                    "status": "CONFLICT",
                    "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
                })
                _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
                return _err("CONFLICT", "This API key is already registered for this workspace/provider.")

    # Generate id
    alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    def _gen_suffix(n=18):
        x = int(time.time() * 1000)
        s = []
        for _ in range(n):
            x = (1103515245 * x + 12345) & 0x7fffffff
            s.append(alphabet[x % len(alphabet)])
        return "".join(s)
    new_id = "brv_key_" + _gen_suffix(18)
    existing_ids = {k.get("id") for k in api_keys if isinstance(k.get("id"), str)}
    while new_id in existing_ids:
        new_id = "brv_key_" + _gen_suffix(18)

    row = {
        "id": new_id,
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "provider": provider,
        "key_name": key_name,
        "key_hash": key_hash,
        "last4": last4,
        "status": "active",
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now)
    }
    api_keys.append(row)
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    # log call (non-billable audit)
    usage_ledger.append({
        "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "api_key_id": new_id,
        "search_request_id": None,
        "event_type": "request",
        "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
        "quantity": 0,
        "billable": False,
        "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now),
        "note": "create_api_key",
        "status": "OK",
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    })
    _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)

    return {"data": row}

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of an API key record, including lifecycle status transitions (active↔disabled, active/disabled→revoked). Returns the updated api_keys record; refuses invalid transitions or attempts to modify revoked keys.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the API key.

key_name.description: New human-readable label for the key.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the key. Allowed transitions: active→disabled|revoked, disabled→active|revoked.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def update_api_key(workspace_id, api_key_id, key_name=None, status=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0193000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0193000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    def _iso(dt):
        if isinstance(dt, str):
            return dt
        return dt.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^brv_ws_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspace_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspace_id.")
    if not isinstance(api_key_id, str) or not re.match(r"^brv_key_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", api_key_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid api_key_id.")
    if key_name is not None:
        if not isinstance(key_name, str) or not (1 <= len(key_name) <= 100):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "key_name must be a non-empty string up to 100 characters.")
    if status is not None:
        if status not in ("active", "disabled", "revoked"):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid status.")

    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json")
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    usage_ledger = _load("usage_ledger.json")

    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if not ws:
        usage_ledger.append({
            "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "search_request_id": None,
            "event_type": "request",
            "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
            "quantity": 0,
            "billable": False,
            "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
            "note": "update_api_key.not_found_workspace",
            "status": "NOT_FOUND",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        })
        _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.")

    idx = None
    row = None
    for i, k in enumerate(api_keys):
        if k.get("id") == api_key_id and k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id:
            idx = i
            row = k
            break
    if not row:
        usage_ledger.append({
            "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "search_request_id": None,
            "event_type": "request",
            "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
            "quantity": 0,
            "billable": False,
            "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
            "note": "update_api_key.not_found_key",
            "status": "NOT_FOUND",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        })
        _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "API key not found for this workspace.")

    if key_name is None and status is None:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "No fields to update. Provide key_name and/or status.")

    # Disallow any modification of revoked keys
    if row.get("status") == "revoked":
        usage_ledger.append({
            "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
            "workspace_id": workspace_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "search_request_id": None,
            "event_type": "request",
            "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
            "quantity": 0,
            "billable": False,
            "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
            "created_at": _iso(now),
            "updated_at": _iso(now),
            "note": "update_api_key.revoked_immutable",
            "status": "INVALID_TRANSITION",
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        })
        _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
        return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Revoked API keys cannot be modified.")

    # Update key_name with uniqueness constraint unique(workspace_id, provider, key_name)
    if key_name is not None and key_name != row.get("key_name"):
        for k in api_keys:
            if k.get("id") != api_key_id and k.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and k.get("provider") == row.get("provider") and k.get("key_name") == key_name:
                usage_ledger.append({
                    "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
                    "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                    "api_key_id": api_key_id,
                    "search_request_id": None,
                    "event_type": "request",
                    "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
                    "quantity": 0,
                    "billable": False,
                    "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
                    "created_at": _iso(now),
                    "updated_at": _iso(now),
                    "note": "update_api_key.conflict_key_name",
                    "status": "CONFLICT",
                    "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
                })
                _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
                return _err("CONFLICT", "An API key with this key_name already exists for this workspace/provider.")
        row["key_name"] = key_name

    # Update status with lifecycle transitions
    if status is not None and status != row.get("status"):
        allowed = {
            "active": {"disabled", "revoked"},
            "disabled": {"active", "revoked"},
            "revoked": set()
        }
        cur = row.get("status")
        if cur not in allowed or status not in allowed[cur]:
            usage_ledger.append({
                "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
                "workspace_id": workspace_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key_id,
                "search_request_id": None,
                "event_type": "request",
                "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
                "quantity": 0,
                "billable": False,
                "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
                "created_at": _iso(now),
                "updated_at": _iso(now),
                "note": "update_api_key.invalid_transition",
                "status": "INVALID_TRANSITION",
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                "from_status": cur,
                "to_status": status
            })
            _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Invalid API key status transition.", from_status=cur, to_status=status)
        row["status"] = status

    row["updated_at"] = _iso(now)
    api_keys[idx] = row
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)

    usage_ledger.append({
        "id": "brv_use_" + now.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S") + "000000000000000000"[:18],
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "search_request_id": None,
        "event_type": "request",
        "tool_name": "brave_web_search",
        "quantity": 0,
        "billable": False,
        "period_month": now.strftime("%Y-%m"),
        "created_at": _iso(now),
        "updated_at": _iso(now),
        "note": "update_api_key",
        "status": "OK",
        "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    })
    _save("usage_ledger.json", usage_ledger)

    return {"data": row}

tool_schemas.name: get_auth_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity and entitlements for this integration, including readable workspaces/scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption for a workspace. Refuses when the presented credential is missing/invalid.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace id to include current month usage and remaining quotas for that workspace.

metadata.name: Brave Search
metadata.description: This backend powers a Brave Search integration that issues web and local search requests, records each search query, stores normalized result items, and tracks API credentials, quotas, and usage for billing/rate-limiting. Primary workflows are: accept a search request (web or local), execute it agai
